sources.title: README.md · orcarouter/Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-GGUF at main
sources.snippet: GGUF conversions of Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored — an abliterated (refusal-removed) build of Qwen's Qwen3.8-27B, a 27B dense hybrid-attention (Gated DeltaNet linear + full attention) native vision-language model with reasoning, tool-calling, and an MTP speculative-decoding head. These files run in llama.cpp (CPU / CUDA / Metal / ROCm), quantized from 2-bit to 16-bit, with a separate mmproj file ...

sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: MathVision: Qwen3.8-27B is evaluated using the fixed prompt: "Please reason step by step, and put your final answer within \boxed {}." For the remaining models, we report the higher score from two prompt variants—one with and one without the \boxed {} formatting requirement.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B Uncensored GGUF: Abliterated Local Build
sources.snippet: Bottom line "Qwen 3.8 27B uncensored GGUF" has an answer, and it is a concrete download: Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-GGUF — F16 plus 12 quantization tiers for llama.cpp, the abliterated weights from our FP8 build, 262K context, vision, and MTP, under Apache 2.0 and research-only.

sources.snippet: Welcome to the repository for Qwen3.8-27B —the latest native multimodal dense open-weight model released by Alibaba's Qwen team. Delivering top-tier performance for local hardware, Qwen3.8-27B excels at coding, agentic workflows, and office automation tasks.

sources.title: Qwen 3.8 27B Uncensored Local: GGUF Quants + llama.cpp
sources.snippet: Run Qwen 3.8 27B uncensored locally: pick the GGUF quant for your VRAM, serve it with llama.cpp or Ollama, and respect the research-only boundary.
